train_transform:
Compose(
    RandomResizedCrop(size=(512, 512), scale=(0.7, 1.0), ratio=(0.75, 1.33), interpolation=bilinear, antialias=True)
    RandomHorizontalFlip(p=0.5)
    RandomVerticalFlip(p=0.5)
    RandomRotation(degrees=[-25.0, 25.0], interpolation=nearest, expand=False, fill=0)
    RandomApply(
    p=0.8
    ColorJitter(brightness=(0.78, 1.22), contrast=(0.78, 1.22), saturation=(0.8, 1.2), hue=(-0.03, 0.03))
)
    RandomGrayscale(p=0.05)
    RandomApply(
    p=0.15
    GaussianBlur(kernel_size=(3, 3), sigma=(0.1, 1.5))
)
    RandomAutocontrast(p=0.1)
    ToTensor()
    Normalize(mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225])
    RandomErasing(p=0.15, scale=(0.02, 0.1), ratio=(0.3, 3.3), value=random, inplace=False)
)
validation_transform:
Compose(
    Resize(size=(512, 512), interpolation=bilinear, max_size=None, antialias=True)
    ToTensor()
    Normalize(mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225])
)
mixup_note: Original microbatch-local randperm; micro1 pairs with itself and makes MixUp ineffective
save_scope: only small preflight receipt; full protected Checkpoint timing measured during formal epochs
cold_start_limit: cycle1 includes worker startup and first optimizer-state allocation; cycle2 is a short necessary sample, not long-term performance
